{{Top|leg}}
'''Naath''' was an individual who was in the employ of the [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] crime boss [[Rej Taunt]]. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Naath accompanied Taunt to the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Second Chance'']] to meet with the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].<ref name="Millennium Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
